description:
Cancel an invoice.

Only while nothing has arrived. Money that arrives later is still seen (the address stays watched) and lands in review.

Test keys only: refused with a live key.

Cannot be undone — Cancels the invoice: its buyer can no longer pay it. Ask the person first, then call with `confirm: true`.

confirm.description: true once the person has agreed to this exact call. Without it nothing is done.

name: cancel_invoice
title: Cancel an invoice
